units.name: ExchangeLinkCartridgeIdentity
units.summary: Send the four-byte cartridge identity, enter handshake state 2 and switch scene. The receive path retries an $FE handshake with bounded random delay, waits for four bytes and compares all identity bytes before entering state 4. A mismatch resets link state; successful setup assigns host/peer role separately.

units.name: BeginLinkIdentityHandshake
units.summary: Send sentinel $FE, then service frames until input arrives or the 100-step timeout wraps; timeout resets the link. Matching peer sentinels introduce a randomized retry to avoid symmetric collision.

units.name: PollLinkIdentityHandshake
units.summary: Require the sentinel exchange followed by four received identity bytes. Compare them against the ROM's identity at $7FF8 before accepting the peer; failure resets serial state.

units.name: BecomeLinkHost
units.summary: Set the host-role bytes, mark the link ready and select serial state 3. Peer setup uses the same ready/state values with the role bytes cleared.

units.name: DispatchReceivedLinkCommand
units.summary: While link-ready, peek the next received command and dispatch through the 18-word table. Individual handlers wait for their complete packet before consuming bytes. Commands update field/ring data, suspension/selection/sequence flags and result latches; no linked-device runtime compatibility is implied.

units.name: ReceiveThreeFieldBytes
units.summary: Require three available bytes and append all three to the field-packet ring. Its low-byte pointer wraps within the upper half-page.

units.name: AppendRemoteFieldPacketByte
units.summary: Store A through the packet write pointer, increment the low byte and force bit 7 to wrap over a 128-byte upper-half-page ring; the high byte stays fixed.

units.name: ReceiveFieldPacketWithZeroTail
units.summary: Append the command byte, consume its receive header and append two zeros to form the three-byte field packet.

units.name: ReceiveSaturatingRemoteCount
units.summary: Wait for a two-byte command, consume its parameter and add it to the remote count with saturation at $FF.

units.name: ReceiveFourGarbagePacketBytes
units.summary: Wait for five available bytes including header; append four payload bytes into the lower-half-page ring with low-byte mask $7F.

units.name: ReceiveSuspendCommand
units.summary: Consume the header and set the remote suspension flag. The next command clears the same flag to resume.

units.name: ReceiveResumeCommand
units.summary: Consume the command header and clear the remote suspension flag.

units.name: ReceiveRemoteMenuChoice
units.summary: Consume a complete header/value packet, store the choice and set its ready latch for the waiting scene command.

units.name: ReceiveOneShotReadyFlag
units.summary: Consume the header only while the handshake latch is clear, then set it. A repeated header is left pending until the consumer acknowledges the previous one.

units.name: ReceiveRemoteFieldOption
units.summary: Consume a complete header/value packet and store the remote field option used by piece-sequence and menu setup.

units.name: ReceiveRemoteOptionConfirmed
units.summary: Consume the header and set the remote option-confirmation latch.

units.name: ReceivePieceSequenceSelector
units.summary: Consume a complete header/value packet, store its selector and set the ready latch used by sequence setup.

units.name: ReceiveSequenceLoadComplete
units.summary: Consume the header and set the sequence-load completion latch.

units.name: ReceiveSequenceAcknowledgement
units.summary: Consume the header and set the acknowledgement latch used by the rewind/wait scene command.

units.name: ReceiveRemoteRowCount
units.summary: Consume a complete header/value packet, store the received row count and mark it ready for field garbage handling.

units.name: ReceiveOneShotTransitionFlag
units.summary: Consume the header only if the transition latch is clear, then set it; the scene consumer owns acknowledgement.

units.name: ReceiveRemoteResultOne
units.summary: Consume the header and set result flag one plus the shared result-ready latch.

units.name: ReceiveRemoteResultTwo
units.summary: Consume the header and set result flag two plus the shared result-ready latch.

units.name: BecomeLinkPeer
units.summary: Clear the host-role bytes, select serial state 3 and mark link readiness; shared send/receive code then uses the peer role.

units.name: CheckLargeObjectLock

units.name: StepLargeObjectSquash

units.name: RunScriptedFourSpriteMotion
units.summary: Consume signed XY step pairs through a task cursor, subtracting each from position. A first byte $80 ends the selected path; select another of four paths when idle. Render four sprites in a diamond arrangement. The following scene/menu helpers share this display and linked result setup.

units.name: SceneInitializeTwoChoiceCursor
units.summary: Load the menu palette and create the two-choice cursor task with tile base $5E.

units.name: ScenePollTwoChoiceMenu
units.summary: Repeat this scene command until confirmation. Up/Down toggle the one-bit choice and queue sound $22; either action button confirms, resets VDP registers through protected frame pacing and advances the scene.

units.name: DrawBlinkingTwoChoiceCursor
units.summary: Derive row position from the one-bit choice and alternate two pairs of tiles on phase bit 5 of a modulo-64 counter. Write the two cursor sprites directly into shared buffers.

units.name: SendLinkSequenceCompletion
units.summary: Send command $0B and return.

units.name: SceneWaitForLinkSequenceCompletion
units.summary: Repeat until the sequence-complete latch arrives, consume it, advance and choose the sound from host role and previous outcome.

units.name: SceneResolveLinkedResult
units.summary: Wait for a result-ready latch, then combine both result flags with host role and the prior winner byte to choose the local result. Consume readiness and advance the scene.

units.name: SceneUpdateLinkedWinCounts
units.summary: Increment the winning side's count, saturating at 99, and update the shared winner byte. Convert and draw two decimal digits per side; blank-leading digit uses tile code ten.

units.name: SceneInitializeLinkedResultDisplay
units.summary: Allocate the 3x8 sprite-grid motion and animated tile-upload tasks, seed position/amplitude and enable frame interrupts.

units.name: SceneWaitForResultAction
units.summary: Repeat this command until either action button is newly pressed; then advance.

units.name: SceneInitializeLinkedChoiceCursor
units.summary: Allocate the common two-choice cursor task with tile base $50.

units.name: ScenePollLinkedChoice
units.summary: Up/Down toggle one-bit choice. Confirmation sends command 6 followed by the choice, queues sound $23 and advances the scene.

units.name: SceneInitializeRemoteResultDisplay
units.summary: Create the same 3x8 sprite display with a different initial position/phase and a palette-cycling task; frame interrupts remain enabled.

units.name: SceneWaitForRemoteChoice
units.summary: Wait for a received choice-ready latch, consume it, copy the remote choice to shared selection and advance the scene.

units.name: MoveLinkedResultSpriteGrid
units.summary: Move a 3x8 sprite grid into view with a wave-based horizontal offset and two-pixel vertical steps, then switch to wave-based vertical bobbing. Task byte +19 selects entry versus idle behavior.

units.name: DrawLinkedResultSpriteGrid
units.summary: Emit 24 sprites in three rows of eight, with X stride eight and Y stride sixteen. Tile numbers advance by two and sprite indexes start at one.

units.name: AnimateLinkedResultTiles
units.summary: Use a wave-derived eight-way index to load two consecutive records from bank eight, then upload 32 bytes each to VRAM $0780/$07C0. Each asset helper restores bank two.

units.name: CycleLinkedResultPalette
units.summary: Every eighth call toggle between the two palette selectors; other calls only advance the divider.

units.name: SceneInitializeLinkedFieldOptions
units.summary: Allocate two option-display tasks with separate positions, data pointers, tile/VRAM descriptors and regional index lists. Save both task handles and clear both option bytes.

units.name: ScenePollLocalFieldOption
units.summary: Repeat while selecting one of five options (0..4); send command 8 plus its value on movement. Confirmation sends command 9, clears the local panel and retires its task. If peer confirmation is already set, clear/retire that panel too.

units.name: SceneWaitForPeerFieldOption
units.summary: Wait for and consume peer confirmation, cancel the scene rewind and clear both option rectangles.

units.name: ReadRemoteGarbageRingByte
units.summary: Preserve HL while reading the lower-half-page ring and advancing its low-byte pointer modulo 128. Return the consumed byte in A.

units.name: SendLocalGarbagePacket
units.summary: When local pending garbage is active, choose a random starting column, send command 3 plus its payload and distribute up to thirty cells. Otherwise send a zero packet and resume the normal phase.

units.name: BuildSixColumnGarbageCounts
units.summary: Clear six column counters, begin at the supplied starting column and distribute the supplied pending count cyclically, decrementing both pending fields and capping a batch at thirty.

units.name: LoadOwningFieldRecordIY
units.summary: Load IY from task +27/+28, the linked field record; preserve the task in IX.

units.name: WriteDistributedGarbageCells
